Barbie - Aventura Submarina.name: Barbie: Ocean Discovery
Barbie - Aventura Submarina.summary:
The Game Boy Color version of Adventures with Barbie: Ocean Discovery.
The PC and GBC versions are slightly different; The dolphin plays a more significant role in Windows than it does in the Game Boy Color version.

Harvest Moon GBC.name: Harvest Moon GBC
Harvest Moon GBC.summary: Harvest Moon GBC is a remaster of the Game Boy game Harvest Moon GB. It was released for the Game Boy Color by Natsume in North America and Nintendo in Europe. In the game, you'll take care of your farm within the in-game year. The game has Game Boy link support where you can trade items with other owners of the game. The game is viewed from a bird's eye perspective.

Trade & Battle Card Hero.name: Trade & Battle: Card Hero
Trade & Battle Card Hero.summary: The first game in the Card Hero franchise by Yoshio Sakamoto and Intelligent Systems.
